name: livevote
description: LiveVote — real-time group polls for a shift team picking dinner. Rebuild of pollingapp (2018).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p client && tsc -p e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run e2e
